title: Yoisaki Kanade — Beyond The Screen...〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
How did you find today's dinner?
Was it to your liking?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It was delicious.
It's more like breakfast for me, though.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You hadn't eaten anything since you woke up, again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I tend to forget when I'm working.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you really need to eat proper meals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
By the way, there's dessert today too.
Do you still have space for some apple pie?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I'll be working late into the night, so I want to eat as much as I can now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here you go.
If you don't mind, I'd like to take a little piece as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you like it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki has a kind smile, but her eyes seem so sad... Just like my father's...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Is there perhaps something troubling her as well?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku. I don't want these people in my world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you ever thought of wanting to...disappear?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... Yes. A little bit, sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, okay. I'm sorry...
That was a strange thing to ask.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Don't be.
I asked you first.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well, in that case...
Could I ask you one more thing?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you do...when you start having such thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
The tea was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The apple pie was good too.
I would love to have it again.
